entries.title: Updates are easier to scan
entries.body: Settings now keeps update controls in one compact row and shows only the latest three notes in collapsed details. When a newer version is available, its status links to the direct Preview APK or the F-Droid page; update checks never start a download automatically.

entries.title: Update checks stay under your control
entries.body: The beta reminder no longer checks for updates by default. Open What's new in Settings and choose Check for updates when you want the latest notes; native installs can optionally enable startup checks, which remain off until you opt in.

entries.title: More reliable Back navigation
entries.body: Back now returns reliably from pages such as Settings instead of leaving you on the same screen. Settings sections use consistent spacing, and the mobile dive list keeps its final record above the Android navigation controls.

entries.title: Fixed the back button
entries.body: Fixed the back button so it returns reliably from pages such as Settings.

entries.title: BLE imports keep the computer dive number
entries.body: Downloads from a classic Shearwater now store the dive number shown on the computer. It appears in the logbook list and as shearwater-ble #N under Imported from. A factory test dive numbered 0 is kept. Dives saved from an older BLE import stay blank until you download them again.

entries.title: Combine split dive segments safely
entries.body: Combine adjacent dive-computer segments without deleting the originals, and unmerge them at any time. The logbook filters now cover named and unnamed sites, gas-pressure data, local edits, and short dives; use Select shown to review the exact filtered set before deleting it. You can also rename trips directly from their headers and choose user-entered coordinates for export. Backups that include combined dives use backup format 5 and should be restored with this or a newer DiveFrame build.

entries.title: Apply catalog coordinates from a site name
entries.body: When a dive has a site name but no GPS, DiveFrame now suggests exact or close matches from the active catalog. Choose a match to apply its catalog coordinates.

entries.title: dive map - added zoom level
entries.body: The Dive Map now has closer zoom levels with more detailed coastlines, plus a light map theme for brighter conditions.

entries.title: New image composer presets
entries.body: Create share images with four refined presets: Bottom Profile, Right Information Panel, Bottom Stats Dock, and Solid Info Band. Every seeded layout can be recreated with the composer controls.

entries.title: Light theme and Memos shortcut
entries.body: Choose Light or Dark in Settings (saved on this device). Long-press the app icon or use the PWA shortcut to open Dive memos.

entries.title: Launched beta test
entries.body: DiveFrame beta testing is open. Import a dive log, try Dive memos, and share feedback.

entries.title: Memo match and top bar
entries.body: Dive detail and Dive memos can suggest nearby memos or dives by time. The top bar is shared across pages (Home, About, Settings, Bluetooth/Android app, memos, Import). Dive dates show HH:MM.

entries.title: UI copy refresh
entries.body: English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese (HK) strings were refreshed across the app. The About page now leads with Why DiveFrame Exists (with a Read more for the rest), then the companion overview, Open source, and Advanced search.

entries.title: Dive memos
entries.body: Jot date, time, location, buddies, and notes before a log exists. Open Dive memos from the import guide.

entries.title: Offline site catalog
entries.body: The bundled dive-site catalog works offline. Import a regional supplement in Settings; it is saved on this device and included in backups.
